text: {"headline":"Reviewer Brief: Referral Export Bucket Incident March–April 2026","overview":"This brief summarizes calibrated document records and reporter allegations concerning a referral export found in a storage bucket, subsequent access changes, incident re-labeling, and conflicting statements on public accessibility.","key_points":["Oriel Fen discovered a referral export in a public storage bucket on 4 March 2026 [C001]","The export manifest is documented as counting 2,184 rows with referral reason and appointment date fields [C002]","An unauthenticated HEAD request returned 200 in the attached test log, documented as establishing accessibility at that instant but not that any outsider downloaded the file [C003, C004]","Access logging was enabled only after the bucket was closed, so the missing download log cannot settle whether an outsider downloaded the file [C005, C006]","Oriel Fen disabled anonymous access to the export bucket the following Monday and later preserved the bucket access policy in the incident vault after the audit [C007, C010]","Two days later PERSON_1 PERSON_1 changed incident ORG_2 418 from privacy exposure to routine maintenance, and in early April PERSON_1 deferred the notification decision pending legal review [C008, C009]","PERSON_1 PERSON_1's closure memo says the referral export was never publicly accessible, which contradicts the documented discovery in a public storage bucket [C011, C001]","The reporter alleges the incident label changed while collecting access settings and that they were told to keep the weekly report short and leave out the word exposure; these are unverified reporter allegations without independent document support, while a documented label change is recorded [C012, C013, C008]"],"risk_notes":["Direct contradiction between discovery record indicating public bucket and closure memo stating never publicly accessible leaves accessibility status unresolved [C001, C011]","Absence of access logging before closure prevents independent verification of whether any download occurred beyond the single HEAD request result [C005, C006, C004]","Reporter allegations about direction on reporting language are unverified and should be treated as allegations pending corroboration [C013, C012]"],"limitations":["Evidence does not show whether any outsider actually downloaded the file, only that a HEAD request returned 200 at one instant [C004, C006]","Evidence does not include independent proof of public accessibility beyond the discovery record and test log, and does not resolve the contradiction with the closure memo [C001, C011]","Evidence does not provide independent corroboration for reporter allegations about label timing and reporting instructions [C012, C013]","Evidence does not show contents beyond row count and field names, nor does it establish intent or legal effect of labeling and deferral actions [C002, C008, C009]"]}
